label: Relational receipt after ST I q.45 a.3: does a real relation to the giver carry the sustaining crux?
summary: The next test named by attempt 50e08b09. Note docs/notes/sustaining-vs-existential-inertia.md section 6; module TruthCore.Causality.RelationalReceipt, spec specs/relational-receipt.toml. Texts read in pinned witnesses: ST I q.45 a.3 (passage fb7bd7bb, newly pinned in the admitted SCTA Leonine transcription; objections, sed contra, corpus, ad 1-3) and ST I q.13 a.7 (passage 12d8ecc5, newly pinned in the same SCTA file as a.5 and a.8); q.104 a.1 re-read. q.45 a.3 co.: creation in the creature is only a relation to the Creator as principle of its esse, as a passion with motion imports a relation to the principle of motion; ad 1: real in the creature, of reason in God; ad 2: passive creation is in the creature and is the creature; ad 3: the creature is the subject of the relation and prior to it in being, but the relation has a certain priority on the side of its term; the creature need not be said to be created (the name) as long as it exists, because creation imports the relation with novelty, which plausibly implies (implicature) that the relation remains without the novelty. q.13 a.7 co.: relations of reason on both sides (including a thing to itself, and a being to a non-being), real on both sides (including those consequent on action and passion, 'motivum et mobile, pater et filius'), and real in one extreme only (knowledge to the knowable); the creature's relation to God is in the third class; ad 6 settles simultaneity by signification and is silent on whether a real relation's term must exist while it is borne. No claim is recorded (the Lean relation is time-indexed; the texts are not). Typed a primitive origin relation (definition 7b28be97), irreflexivity and non-mutuality predicates, and a third sense of present receipt, RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_3 relationalReceipt (definition 2a7f7142, appended to disambiguation 71d3bdb7): standing receipt plus a real relation borne at the moment to something as to the principle of being. Open premises: foundation ef7ef827, accompaniment 9fecbef4, coexistence of the term 264b6b5e, giving by the term 6da7d94a. Results: accompaniment + giving by the term give 40a97664 (a0b5227d, transcription); on RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_3 the present-tense reading is accompaniment (42590821); given accompaniment, relational correlativity is equivalent to 40a97664 (1637b89a); with the relation left open, a founded accompanying relation with a giving term exists iff 40a97664 (b5e9b376); foundation + irreflexivity + non-mutuality + accompaniment + coexistence of the term + received onset given do not entail 40a97664 (b9920133). Controls 584bac58: (1) a creator present throughout who gives being at onset only, with the relation persisting, satisfies foundation, irreflexivity, non-mutuality, accompaniment, coexistence and received onset and falsifies giving by the term and 40a97664; (2) relation at onset only (an analyst variant, not a model of ad 3) satisfies giving by the term and falsifies accompaniment; (3) a term absent after onset falsifies coexistence; (4) sustaining satisfies all; (5) another giver: 40a97664 holds and giving by the term fails, so for a fixed relation giving by the term is strictly stronger than 40a97664. truth countermodel does not support History-typed parameters, so controls are hand-built and Lean-checked. Finding: the independently warranted structure the relation adds (existing term, irreflexivity, non-mutuality, from q.13 a.7) does not reach giving; given accompaniment, relational correlativity is equivalent to 40a97664; giving by the term is sufficient with accompaniment, not shown minimal. No item is added to inertia's price; the section 4 judgment stands. Rival and reply, under the Substantive Objection Standard applied to both: the rival models the creature's relation on filiation (q.13 a.7 lists pater et filius among real relations consequent on action; persistence after begetting is ordinary use), but that is a second-class relation while q.13 a.7 puts the creature's relation in the third, and filiation follows a cause of becoming, so the rival carries the becoming profile to esse, which presupposes the rival; the sustaining reply (a relation to a cause of being holds only while it acts, q.104 a.1) carries the illumination profile to esse, which presupposes 40a97664; q.45 a.3 co.'s motion analogy points toward the mover-moved profile but attributes the crux rather than warranting it. A standoff. The dead-father variant is excluded by coexistence of the term. An independent semantic challenge of the first draft (6ff57610f) found 5 P1 and 6 P2 findings: overstating giving by the term as exactly the crux; an exhaustion claim resting on a result about weaker receipts only; the third-class classification and ad 2/ad 3 priority omitted; asymmetric treatment of the rival and the reply; the ad 3 novelty clause misread as the relation's duration; plus ad 6 overstatement, the motion analogy mis-mapped to the passion sense, foundation over-described, missing irreflexivity, the definition's sourcing condition and a missing disambiguation link. All were repaired; irreflexivity, non-mutuality and control part 5 were added. Side finding: accompaniment and coexistence give only some term present at each moment of presence, not the single, tenseless, distinct cause co-present in every history that the antecedent of co-presence bridge ffcb81fb needs; no premise moves.
blocker: Branch reassessment, not exhaustion: three readings of present receipt are typed (passion, standing composition, relation), each locating the crux in one premise, and no general result excludes a further reading. Next vertical tests, untyped: the third-class (ordination or measure) reading that q.13 a.7 gives this relation, whose exemplar (knowledge to the knowable) involves no action of the term; and the priority on the side of the term in q.45 a.3 ad 3. Horizontal tests: an argument from another family that persistence at t needs an explanation at t (PSR variant for persistence, contingency family) without the illumination or extended actualization premises; a participation-family account of received esse on which participated act is not a completed terminus, with warrant not assuming 40a97664; a matching-scope comparison of inertia's positive commitments with the sustaining account. Unread lead for the rival: Metaph. Delta 15 1021a21-26 and In V Metaph. lect. 17 (relations by action divided by time).
